title: The Filter by Technician multi-select starts with every technician selected on a first visit
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Technician Utilization report on a first visit (no saved settings), with several technicians in the range.
custom_steps:
1. Find the toolbar filter labeled "Filter by Technician" and open it.
2. Check the selection state of every listed technician.
3. Try selecting more than one change at once (multi-select).
custom_expected:
1. The toolbar has a filter labeled "Filter by Technician" that allows selecting more than one technician.
2. On the first visit, EVERY technician is selected.
3. All technicians' rows are shown.
